description: Labeled test sets for scoring candidate models. Never train on these frames. Built by scripts/build_testset.py.

testsets.name: test_clips
testsets.empty_frames_note: Labeled by the user in CVAT on 2026-10-26 and left with no boxes (cones not yet in view, or bare sidewalk); CVAT's YOLO export writes no file for them, but lists them in train.txt.

testsets.name: track_fence
testsets.exclude_ranges_note: Keeps only frames 1430-1960: traffic cones behind the running-track fence, a benchmark for distant and occluded cones (user decision 2026-10-26). Scored on its own, not toward the cone target.
